channel.title: Hashbeam
channel.description: Hashbeam reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network security, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and market structure across blockchains and tokens.

item.title: Native ETH and WETH Quotes: Compare the Route, Not the Label
item.description: ETH and WETH redeem at par, but their quotes can differ because routes, liquidity, fees and gas differ; compare the same trade and its full execution cost.

item.title: What a Wallet Signature Authorizes in an Inventory Trade
item.description: A wallet signature can authorize an inventory trade without moving tokens immediately; the contract still checks the order, allowance and available balance at execution.

item.title: How to Track a Cross-Chain Treasury Payout
item.description: A wallet signature starts a payout, but settlement can span contracts and chains; track the source event, message status and destination transfer separately.

item.title: Four Stages That Set Your XMR-to-Bitcoin Swap Time
item.description: An XMR-to-Bitcoin swap waits on setup, Monero settlement and Bitcoin confirmations; the slowest confirmation gate, chosen depth and any service queue set its duration.

item.title: What Wallet Users Should Check in a Stablecoin Bridge Route
item.description: Stablecoin bridge routes can burn and remint a native token or use pooled liquidity; compare the destination asset, fees and completion steps before signing.

item.title: SEC proposes conditional crypto self-custody rules for advisers
item.description: The SEC proposed a conditional route for advisers to hold clients’ crypto keys, adding safeguards and board oversight while leaving the plan open to public comment.

item.title: SEC proposes conditional crypto custody routes for advisers and funds
item.description: The SEC proposed rules letting advisers and regulated funds use state trust companies or, when no qualified custodian is available, hold crypto under safeguards.

item.title: How chainflip Moves Native Assets Across Chains
item.description: chainflip routes a wallet deposit through validator witnessing and State Chain liquidity, then pays the native output to your chosen address on another chain.

item.title: Base Cobalt adds conditional transactions and B20 controls
item.description: Base activated Cobalt on mainnet, adding validity transactions and B20 controls that gate inclusion by chain state and give issuers new policy tools.
